fields.Name: Post Task Assignment to Teams
fields.Description: Posts a card naming a newly assigned task and its assignee to a Microsoft Teams channel. Set it as a Task Type's OnAssign action. The channel's webhook URL comes from a 'Teams Channel Webhook' credential: the one named in CredentialName, else the one named after the task type's Code, else the credential type's default. Accepts Office 365 connector and Power Automate Workflows webhook URLs.
fields.UserPrompt: Post a task assignment to a Teams channel.

fields.Name: TaskID
fields.Description: ID of the assigned task. Passed by the OnAssign hook.

fields.Name: TaskName
fields.Description: Name of the assigned task. Passed by the OnAssign hook.

fields.Name: TaskTypeID
fields.Description: ID of the task's type, used to find the credential named after its Code. Passed by the OnAssign hook.

fields.Name: AssigneePersonID
fields.Description: People record ID of the assignee. Passed by the OnAssign hook.

fields.Name: AssigneeName
fields.Description: Display name of the assignee, shown on the card. Passed by the OnAssign hook.

fields.Name: Status
fields.Description: Status of the task. Passed by the OnAssign hook; not used.

fields.Name: CredentialName
fields.Description: Name of the 'Teams Channel Webhook' credential to use. Optional; defaults to the task type's Code.
TaskID or TaskName was not supplied.
No 'Teams Channel Webhook' credential matched and the type has no default.
The credential's webhookUrl is not an https Teams connector or Power Automate webhook URL.
The webhook rejected the post or could not be reached.
